judgement.doubts: The earlier human correction (claimed -> partial) is right: a max-degree class is a case (F1). AI role is the closest call: Claude Code and Codex were used 'extensively' for 'proof exploration', which could hide AI-originated arguments, but the author states they selected the arguments and methods and the certificate catalogue came from an integer-constraint search, not an AI; on the quote as written this is none. Both case events share tier partial with role none, so step 4 does not change the AI role. The 2405.11409 date of 18 May 2024 comes from the record's summary; the hypergraph event's month is inferred from the arXiv identifier and is irrelevant to the codes.
